# Shramko Asystent Urzędnika

> Open brief and reference design by Andrii Shramko for an AI assistant for Polish public offices: it helps clerks analyse access-to-public-information requests (UDIP, wnioski o udostępnienie informacji publicznej) and draft answers with a verified legal basis, and it pre-fills official forms from data a visitor enters once. Prepared for HackNation 2026 (Bydgoszcz), challenge "Inteligentny asystent urzędnika". Research is dated 2026-11-20 and labelled verified, secondary or unverified. MIT (code) and CC BY 4.0 (documents): https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-asystent-urzednika

## Key facts
- UDIP deadline: without undue delay, at most 14 days from filing; one extension only if announced within those 14 days, at most 2 months from filing (art. 13 of the Act of 6 September 2001).
- Only refusal and discontinuance are administrative decisions (art. 16); "not public information", "not held" and "another access regime" are answered by an ordinary letter, still within 14 days.
- Case law of 2024–2026 allows an office to require identification of the applicant of an anonymous request; earlier case law accepted anonymous e-mail requests.
- HackNation 2026: full task cards at Sat 21.11.2026 11:00; draft in HackTribe by Sat 20:00; final submission Sun 11:00 with a PDF presentation up to 10 MB; finals are a 5-minute pitch plus 5 minutes of questions.
- The repository contains a machine-readable catalogue of service cards and form files of Urząd Miasta Bydgoszczy (links and metadata only).
- Design rule: centralise form descriptions, not personal data; personal data stays with the person and the office handling the case.
- mObywatel has a QR-based data-sharing flow for selected partner institutions ("Przekaż instytucji", since 2020); no public interface or sandbox for it was found as of November 2026.
- A resident profile fills about 55-60 % of the fields of simple resident forms and about 36 % across 32 analysed forms of the city hall (own estimate).
- Catalogue size: 275 service cards and 710 form files of Urząd Miasta Bydgoszczy.

## Documents
- [README](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-asystent-urzednika#readme): overview, questions answered, limits
- [Scope decision](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-asystent-urzednika/blob/main/docs/01-product/scope-decision.md): what to build for the jury, the wider platform, one database for many institutions
- [UDIP law and process](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-asystent-urzednika/blob/main/research/02-udip-law-process-taxonomy.md): statute, decision tree of the clerk, response documents, data sources
- [HackNation rules and judging](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-asystent-urzednika/blob/main/research/01-hacknation-2026-task-rules-jury.md): schedule, deliverables, criteria of 2025, jury questions
- [Lessons from a 2022 prototype](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-asystent-urzednika/blob/main/research/09-lessons-from-2022-prototype.md): pre-filled forms in a refugee help centre
- [Forms catalogue](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-asystent-urzednika/blob/main/data/forms-catalog.csv): service cards and form files of Urząd Miasta Bydgoszczy

- [Site and pitch deck](https://urzad.flyreelstudio.eu/): landing page and animated deck with a presenter window
- [mObywatel, registers and once-only](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-asystent-urzednika/blob/main/research/04-mobywatel-identity-once-only.md): what can lawfully feed resident data into an office form
- [Data protection, AI regulation, model providers](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-asystent-urzednika/blob/main/research/05-rodo-ai-act-security-requirements.md): legal bases, identity documents, 26 controls
- [Form anatomy and canonical profile](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-asystent-urzednika/blob/main/research/03b-form-anatomy-and-canonical-profile.md): statutory templates, overlay printing, share of fields a profile fills
- [Known traps](https://github.com/AndriiShramko/shramko-asystent-urzednika/blob/main/docs/warnings.md): law, data, software and agent pitfalls
